subject: Signal and System
questionText:
Consider three signals x1(t) = u(t) – u(t – 1), x2 (t) = 
r(t) – r(t – 2) and x3 (t) = (1 + e–6t) u(t) where u(t) and 
r(t) are unit-step function and unit-ramp function 
respectively. Which of the above signals have finite 
energy? 
 
(a) x1 (t) and x3(t) 
 
(b) 
x1 (t) only 
 
(c) x2 (t) and x3 (t) 
(d) x2 (t) only
explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-08 (Periodic/Aperiodic, Even/odd,).
